protected_assets.description: Durable Session workspace binding and canonical execution root
User files in selected and automatically created directories

trusted_assumptions.description: Current user account, OS kernel and deterministic gate are trusted
A directory confirmed through the native picker represents workspace intent

in_scope_failures.description: Default workspace creation collides, drifts, or leaves a half-bound Session
Production traffic is wired through a legacy workspace seam

maximum_acceptable_impact: A failure may reject only the current Session creation and must not alter other bindings or user files.
